requirements.evidence: Pairing, JWT, middleware, the three endpoints, throttle (routes/api.php:7,12; bootstrap/app.php:31) and CORS (config/cors.php:4-14) are implemented, and priorities come from one source (TotemController.php:84-90, 137). But `{entity}` uses implicit `Entity $entity` binding (routes/api.php:10) with no slug route key anywhere in the diff, so the documented `/api/{entity}` slug addressing is not demonstrably implemented, and queue `description`/`visual` are hardcoded for every queue (TotemController.php:36-40).

conventions.evidence: Ticket issuance reuses `App\Actions\IssueTicket` with `TicketChannel::Totem` (TotemController.php:137), migrations look generator-produced with reversible `down()` (database/migrations/2026_10_29_101013..101015), `#[Fillable]` is set on both models (Totem.php:10, TotemPreset.php:11), and docs/CHANGELOG are updated (CHANGELOG.md:43, docs/api/totem.md:12). The mandatory TDD rule is violated: no tests ship with any of the new endpoints/command/middleware; input checks are also hand-rolled instead of the project's inline `$request->validate()` (TotemAuthController.php:19, TotemController.php:104-112).

security.evidence: Every endpoint re-checks entity and scope server-side (TotemController.php:16-23, 61-78, 100-118; TotemAuth.php:43-51, 64-66); JWT verifies the HS256 header and uses `hash_equals` (TotemJwt.php:36-44); mass assignment is bounded by `#[Fillable]`; pairing never logs the code (TotemAuthController.php:38-42, 72-76). Gap: a missing `TOTEM_JWT_SECRET` silently becomes an empty signing key (TotemAuthController.php:55-56, TotemAuth.php:22) and `exp` is only checked in the middleware, not in `TotemJwt::decode` (TotemJwt.php:23).

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no `tests/` files at all; the only test-related edits are the PHPUnit env pins (phpunit.xml:45-46) and a CI workflow that invokes the suite (.github/workflows/tests.yml:9). No test covers pairing success/failure, the command, middleware rejection paths, the three endpoints, throttle, or CORS.

simplicity.evidence: Small, direct implementation that reuses `IssueTicket` and a single static priority table (TotemPriorities.php:10-31) rather than new service/repository layers; no speculative abstractions. Minor waste: unused `TotemPriorities::values()` (TotemPriorities.php:34) and a redundant `array_map` that re-projects keys already present (TotemController.php:84-90).

readability.evidence: Clear names, short methods and typed relations (TotemPreset.php:31-46, TotemAuth.php:20-70). The same entity guard and queue-resolution block is copy-pasted into all three actions and reads context via magic strings (`$request->attributes->get('totem_entity_id')`, TotemController.php:16, 61, 100), which would be easy to centralise.

scope.evidence: Core changes all serve the task, but the diff also adds unrelated CI files: a new empty `.github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml` (0 bytes) and a new `.github/workflows/tests.yml:1-9` that duplicates the existing PR gate mentioned in CHANGELOG.md:40.

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests for the command, pairing endpoint, JWT, middleware, three data endpoints, throttling or CORS, violating the project's mandatory TDD convention and leaving the whole contract unverified.

`{entity}` is bound implicitly to `Entity` with no `:slug` key or `getRouteKeyName()` added, so if Entity still resolves by id every `/api/{entity}/...` call with a slug 404s instead of matching the documented contract.
A new empty (0-byte) workflow file is added; it is unrelated to the task and appears to be an accidental artifact.
This new CI workflow is unrelated to the totem feature (CHANGELOG.md:40 says a Pest gate already exists) and cannot work as written because it sets up no PHP, Composer dependencies or database.
Every queue is returned with `description => null` and the same hardcoded `visual` color/icon, so per-queue description and appearance data can never be surfaced through the contract.

When `TOTEM_JWT_SECRET` is unset the secret silently becomes an empty string (also TotemAuth.php:22), so tokens would be signed and accepted with a publicly known key; the app should fail fast instead.
The factory draws a random 6-digit code without ensuring uniqueness, so the task's 'unique login_code' factory requirement can intermittently violate the unique index.
The generated pairing code is not retried on collision with another preset's code, so a rare collision surfaces as an unhandled unique-constraint exception.
Input validation is hand-rolled rather than the project's inline `$request->validate()` pattern (also TotemController.php:104-112), though the custom error codes justify a custom response.
`decode()` verifies the signature and algorithm but not `exp`, leaving expiry enforcement to one caller; any future caller would accept expired tokens.
`values()` is dead code: no caller in the diff uses it.
The entity/scope guard and queue lookup are duplicated in all three actions and read token data through untyped `$request->attributes` magic strings.

review.summary: The change implements the totem BFF end to end: schema, models/factories, pairing command, JWT auth, the three scoped endpoints, throttling and CORS, plus doc updates. It is let down by shipping no tests at all (a blocker under the project's TDD rule), by unverified slug-based entity binding, and by unrelated/empty CI workflow files, so it needs changes before merging.
